title: Lifelong Wandering: A realistic few-shot online continual learning setting
review_status: full-text audit complete; stream protocol, online/forgetting metrics, result table, and scope limitations checked
venue_year_verified: CVPR 2022 Workshop stated in paper; arXiv v1 dated 2022-06-16
evidence_note: RoamingRooms/Matterport3D; four environments × 100 frames, 40% labelled, batch size one. CPM online accuracy/forgetting 73.26±5.11/31.11±7.65; OAP 69.23±5.57/5.91±3.39; LwF 56.03±6.79/2.38±4.82. Replay omitted for storage/privacy realism; frozen ResNet-12 feature extractor at evaluation. Not comparable numerically to LLM studies.

title: Analyzing and Reducing Catastrophic Forgetting in Parameter Efficient Tuning
review_status: full-text audit complete; I-LoRA method, sample/replay protocol, metrics, results, internal count discrepancy, and limitations checked
sections_checked: Sections 3-4 mode-connectivity method and dual-memory replay algorithm
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-02-29; venue not independently checked
evidence_note: Llama-2-7B; eight task columns although table caption says nine; 5,000 train/500 eval samples per task. I-LoRA couples LoRA fast/slow learners with historical-example replay and embedding preservation. Highest listed average accuracy in 7/8 task columns, but EWC leads MeetingBank (35.9 vs 30.6). BWT remains negative on seven of eight sequences, including −12.7 MeetingBank. Theoretical mode-connectivity analysis is listed as future work.

title: Controlled Low-Rank Adaptation with Subspace Regularization for Continued Training on Large Language Models
review_status: full-text audit complete; one-stage and continual settings, metric definitions, task-order outcomes, and author-listed limitations checked
sections_checked: Section 5.1 one-stage Llama-2-7B experiments and Tables 2-4
venue_year_verified: arXiv v2 dated 2025-03-21; initial arXiv submission 2024-10-22; venue not independently checked
evidence_note: Replay-free subspace regularization. One-stage results show task-dependent k behavior (commonsense and math differ); parameter/output-change forgetting proxy is not BWT. Separate T5-large continual table reports CLoRA 79.0 vs O-LoRA 75.8 on standard benchmark, but 68.1 vs 69.6 on large-task benchmark. Authors note random regularizer initialization and scale-based capacity/forgetting measures as limitations.
